content.comment_body: Hello everyone, My [product_name] and PC are both connected to the router, and they communicate without issues. However, when I try to monitor remotely using the app, I am unable to connect. I've confirmed that port 80 is forwarded to my [product_name] IP address, but the remote connection still fails. Any suggestions would be appreciated!

Hello, To access your [product_name] from outside your local network, remote access needs to be specifically enabled. In [product_name] programming software [version_no], go to Tools > Transfer > Access Control. Here, allow remote connections and set a password. Make sure to click 'Apply' for each section individually so the settings are saved to the [product_name]. Hope this helps!

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter challenges with remote monitoring of [product_name] when trying to access it through an app outside their local network. Even with successful LAN communication and port forwarding set to port 80, remote access is unsuccessful, highlighting the need for clear guidance on enabling and configuring remote access options within the software.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an easy remote monitoring setup through the app after configuring port forwarding, without needing to navigate complex or unclear software settings.
